en.headline: Observatory issues Red Fire Danger Warning as risk turns extreme
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the fire danger warning to red at 6 a.m. today, warning of extreme fire risk in the countryside.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Red Fire Danger Warning at 6:00 a.m. on Saturday, stating that the fire risk is extreme.
The Observatory said the countryside is extremely vulnerable to fire and reminded the public to be extra alert and ensure necessary fire precautions are taken.

People planning outdoor activities in the countryside were advised to take pre-cooked food for picnics and to take all measures to prevent hill fires. The penalty for lighting fires illegally in the countryside is HK$25,000 and a year's imprisonment.
The warning remains in force until further notice from the Observatory.

zh.headline: 天文台發出紅色火災危險警告 火警風險極高
zh.dek: 香港天文台今早六時將火災危險警告提升至紅色，警告郊野火警風險極高。
body: 香港天文台於星期六上午六時正發出紅色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性極高。
天文台表示，郊野地區極易發生火警，提醒市民特別提高警覺，並確保採取適當防火措施。
計劃到郊野活動的市民應自備熟食野餐，並採取一切措施防止山火。在郊野非法生火的罰則為罰款二萬五千元及監禁一年。
警告將持續生效，直至天文台另行通知。
